name: Mausala Parva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ShaTtri.nshe tvatha samprApte varShe kauravanandanaH |
dadarsha viparItAni nimittAni yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
vavurvAtAH sanirghAtA rUkShAH sharkaravarShiNaH |
apasavyAni shakunA maNDalAni prachakrire
shlokas.4:
Adityo rajasA rAjansamavachChannamaNDalaH |
virashmirudaye nityaM kabandhaiH samadRRishyata
shlokas.5:
pariveShAshcha dRRishyante dAruNAH chandrasUryayoH |
trivarNAH shyAmarUkShAntAstathA bhasmAruNaprabhAH
shlokas.6:
ete chAnye cha bahava utpAtA bhayasha.nsinaH |
dRRishyante.aharaho rAjanhRRidayodvegakArakAH
shlokas.7:
kasyachittvatha kAlasya kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
shushrAva vRRiShNichakrasya mausale kadanaM kRRitam
shlokas.8:
vimuktaM vAsudevaM cha shrutvA rAmaM cha pANDavaH |
samAnIyAbravIdbhrAtR^InkiM kariShyAma ityuta
shlokas.9:
parasparaM samAsAdya brahmadaNDabalAtkRRitAn |
vRRiShNInvinaShTA.nste shrutvA vyathitAH pANDavAbhavan
shlokas.10:
nidhanaM vAsudevasya samudrasyeva shoShaNam |
vIrA na shraddadhustasya vinAshaM shAr~NgadhanvanaH
shlokas.11:
mausalaM te parishrutya duHkhashokasamanvitAH |
viShaNNA hatasa~NkalpAH pANDavAH samupAvishan

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kathaM vinaShTA bhagavannandhakA vRRiShNibhiH saha |
pashyato vAsudevasya bhojAshchaiva mahArathAH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ShaTtri.nshe.atha tato varShe vRRiShNInAmanayo mahAn |
anyonyaM musalaiste tu nijaghnuH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.3:
janamejaya uvAcha||
kenAnushaptAste vIrAH kShayaM vRRiShNyandhakA yayuH |
bhojAshcha dvijavarya tvaM vistareNa vadasva me
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vishvAmitraM cha kaNvaM cha nAradaM cha tapodhanam |
sAraNapramukhA vIrA dadRRishurdvArakAgatAn
shlokas.5:
te vai sAmbaM puraskRRitya bhUShayitvA striyaM yathA |
abruvannupasa~Ngamya daivadaNDanipIDitAH
shlokas.6:
iyaM strI putrakAmasya babhroramitatejasaH |
RRiShayaH sAdhu jAnIta kimiyaM janayiShyati
shlokas.7:
ityuktAste tadA rAjanvipralambhapradharShitAH |
pratyabruva.nstAnmunayo yattachChRRiNu narAdhipa
shlokas.8:
vRRiShNyandhakavinAshAya musalaM ghoramAyasam |
vAsudevasya dAyAdaH sAmbo.ayaM janayiShyati
shlokas.9:
yena yUyaM sudurvRRittA nRRisha.nsA jAtamanyavaH |
uchChettAraH kulaM kRRitsnamRRite rAmajanArdanau
shlokas.10:
samudraM yAsyati shrImA.nstyaktvA dehaM halAyudhaH |
jarA kRRiShNaM mahAtmAnaM shayAnaM bhuvi bhetsyati
shlokas.11:
ityabruvanta te rAjanpralabdhAstairdurAtmabhiH |
munayaH krodharaktAkShAH samIkShyAtha parasparam
shlokas.13:
tathoktvA munayaste tu tataH keshavamabhyayuH |
athAbravIttadA vRRiShNI~nshrutvaivaM madhusUdanaH |
antaj~no matimA.nstasya bhavitavyaM tatheti tAn
shlokas.14:
evamuktvA hRRiShIkeshaH pravivesha punargRRihAn |
kRRitAntamanyathA naichChatkartuM sa jagataH prabhuH
shlokas.15:
shvobhUte.atha tataH sAmbo musalaM tadasUta vai |
vRRiShNyandhakavinAshAya ki~NkarapratimaM mahat
shlokas.16:
prasUtaM shApajaM ghoraM tachcha rAj~ne nyavedayan |
viShaNNarUpastadrAjA sUkShmaM chUrNamakArayat
shlokas.17:
prAkShipansAgare tachcha puruShA rAjashAsanAt |
aghoShaya.nshcha nagare vachanAdAhukasya cha
shlokas.18:
adya prabhRRiti sarveShu vRRiShNyandhakagRRiheShviha |
surAsavo na kartavyaH sarvairnagaravAsibhiH
shlokas.19:
yashcha no.aviditaM kuryAtpeyaM kashchinnaraH kvachit |
jIvansa shUlamArohetsvayaM kRRitvA sabAndhavaH
shlokas.20:
tato rAjabhayAtsarve niyamaM chakrire tadA |
narAH shAsanamAj~nAya tasya rAj~no mahAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM prayatamAnAnAM vRRiShNInAmandhakaiH saha |
kAlo gRRihANi sarveShAM parichakrAma nityashaH
shlokas.2:
karAlo vikaTo muNDaH puruShaH kRRiShNapi~NgalaH |
gRRihANyavekShya vRRiShNInAM nAdRRishyata punaH kvachit
shlokas.3:
utpedire mahAvAtA dAruNAshchA dine dine |
vRRiShNyandhakavinAshAya bahavo romaharShaNAH
shlokas.4:
vivRRiddhamUShakA rathyA vibhinnamaNikAstathA |
chIchIkUchIti vAshyantyaH sArikA vRRiShNiveshmasu
nopashAmyati shabdashcha sa divArAtrameva hi
shlokas.5:
anukurvannulUkAnAM sArasA virutaM tathA |
ajAH shivAnAM cha rutamanvakurvata bhArata
shlokas.6:
pANDurA raktapAdAshcha vihagAH kAlachoditAH |
vRRiShNyandhakAnAM geheShu kapotA vyachara.nstadA
shlokas.7:
vyajAyanta kharA goShu karabhAshvatarIShu cha |
shunIShvapi biDAlAshcha mUShakA nakulIShu cha
shlokas.8:
nApatrapanta pApAni kurvanto vRRiShNayastadA |
prAdviShanbrAhmaNA.nshchApi pitR^IndevA.nstathaiva cha
shlokas.9:
gurU.nshchApyavamanyanta na tu rAmajanArdanau |
patnyaH patInvyuchcharanta patnIshcha patayastathA
shlokas.10:
vibhAvasuH prajvalito vAmaM viparivartate |
nIlalohitamA~njiShThA visRRijannarchiShaH pRRithak
shlokas.11:
udayAstamane nityaM puryAM tasyAM divAkaraH |
vyadRRishyatAsakRRitpumbhiH kabandhaiH parivAritaH
shlokas.12:
mahAnaseShu siddhe.anne sa.nskRRite.atIva bhArata |
AhAryamANe kRRimayo vyadRRishyanta narAdhipa
shlokas.13:
puNyAhe vAchyamAne cha japatsu cha mahAtmasu |
abhidhAvantaH shrUyante na chAdRRishyata kashchana
shlokas.14:
parasparaM cha nakShatraM hanyamAnaM punaH punaH |
grahairapashyansarve te nAtmanastu katha~nchana
shlokas.15:
nadantaM pA~nchajanyaM cha vRRiShNyandhakaniveshane |
samantAtpratyavAshyanta rAsabhA dAruNasvarAH
shlokas.16:
evaM pashyanhRRiShIkeshaH samprAptaM kAlaparyayam |
trayodashyAmamAvAsyAM tAM dRRiShTvA prAbravIdidam
shlokas.17:
chaturdashI pa~nchadashI kRRiteyaM rAhuNA punaH |
tadA cha bhArate yuddhe prAptA chAdya kShayAya naH
shlokas.18:
vimRRishanneva kAlaM taM parichintya janArdanaH |
mene prAptaM sa ShaTtri.nshaM varShaM vai keshisUdanaH
shlokas.19:
putrashokAbhisantaptA gAndhArI hatabAndhavA |
yadanuvyAjahArArtA tadidaM samupAgatam
shlokas.20:
idaM cha tadanuprAptamabravIdyadyudhiShThiraH |
purA vyUDheShvanIkeShu dRRiShTvotpAtAnsudAruNAn
shlokas.21:
ityuktvA vAsudevastu chikIrShansatyameva tat |
Aj~nApayAmAsa tadA tIrthayAtrAmari.ndama
shlokas.22:
aghoShayanta puruShAstatra keshavashAsanAt |
tIrthayAtrA samudre vaH kAryeti puruSharShabhAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kAlI strI pANDurairdantaiH pravishya hasatI nishi |
striyaH svapneShu muShNantI dvArakAM paridhAvati
shlokas.2:
ala~NkArAshcha ChatraM cha dhvajAshcha kavachAni cha |
hriyamANAnyadRRishyanta rakShobhiH subhayAnakaiH
shlokas.3:
tachchAgnidattaM kRRiShNasya vajranAbhamayasmayam |
divamAchakrame chakraM vRRiShNInAM pashyatAM tadA
shlokas.4:
yuktaM rathaM divyamAdityavarNaM; hayAharanpashyato dArukasya |
te sAgarasyopariShThAdavarta;nmanojavAshchaturo vAjimukhyAH
shlokas.5:
tAlaH suparNashcha mahAdhvajau tau; supUjitau rAmajanArdanAbhyAm |
uchchairjahrurapsaraso divAnishaM; vAchashchochurgamyatAM tIrthayAtrA
shlokas.7:
tato bhojyaM cha bhakShyaM cha peyaM chAndhakavRRiShNayaH |
bahu nAnAvidhaM chakrurmadyaM mA.nsamanekashaH
shlokas.8:
tataH sIdhuShu saktAshcha niryayurnagarAdbahiH |
yAnairashvairgajaishchaiva shrImantastigmatejasaH
shlokas.9:
tataH prabhAse nyavasanyathoddeshaM yathAgRRiham |
prabhUtabhakShyapeyAste sadArA yAdavAstadA
shlokas.10:
niviShTA.nstAnnishamyAtha samudrAnte sa yogavit |
jagAmAmantrya tAnvIrAnuddhavo.arthavishAradaH
shlokas.11:
taM prasthitaM mahAtmAnamabhivAdya kRRitA~njalim |
jAnanvinAshaM vRRiShNInAM naichChadvArayituM hariH
shlokas.12:
tataH kAlaparItAste vRRiShNyandhakamahArathAH |
apashyannuddhavaM yAntaM tejasAvRRitya rodasI
shlokas.13:
brAhmaNArtheShu yatsiddhamannaM teShAM mahAtmanAm |
tadvAnarebhyaH pradaduH surAgandhasamanvitam
shlokas.14:
tatastUryashatAkIrNaM naTanartakasa~Nkulam |
prAvartata mahApAnaM prabhAse tigmatejasAm
shlokas.15:
kRRiShNasya saMnidhau rAmaH sahitaH kRRitavarmaNA |
apibadyuyudhAnashcha gado babhrustathaiva cha
shlokas.16:
tataH pariShado madhye yuyudhAno madotkaTaH |
abravItkRRitavarmANamavahasyAvamanya cha
shlokas.17:
kaH kShatriyo manyamAnaH suptAnhanyAnmRRitAniva |
na tanmRRiShyanti hArdikya yAdavA yattvayA kRRitam
shlokas.18:
ityukte yuyudhAnena pUjayAmAsa tadvachaH |
pradyumno rathinAM shreShTho hArdikyamavamanya cha
shlokas.19:
tataH paramasa~NkruddhaH kRRitavarmA tamabravIt |
nirdishanniva sAvaj~naM tadA savyena pANinA
shlokas.20:
bhUrishravAshChinnabAhuryuddhe prAyagatastvayA |
vadhena sunRRisha.nsena kathaM vIreNa pAtitaH
shlokas.21:
iti tasya vachaH shrutvA keshavaH paravIrahA |
tiryaksaroShayA dRRiShTyA vIkShAM chakre sa manyumAn
shlokas.22:
maNiH syamantakashchaiva yaH sa satrAjito.abhavat |
tAM kathAM smArayAmAsa sAtyakirmadhusUdanam
shlokas.23:
tachChrutvA keshavasyA~NkamagamadrudatI tadA |
satyabhAmA prakupitA kopayantI janArdanam
shlokas.24:
tata utthAya sakrodhaH sAtyakirvAkyamabravIt |
pa~nchAnAM draupadeyAnAM dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinoH
shlokas.25:
eSha gachChAmi padavIM satyena cha tathA shape |
sauptike ye cha nihatAH suptAnena durAtmanA
shlokas.26:
droNaputrasahAyena pApena kRRitavarmaNA |
samAptamAyurasyAdya yashashchApi sumadhyame
shlokas.27:
itIdamuktvA khaDgena keshavasya samIpataH |
abhidrutya shiraH kruddhashchichCheda kRRitavarmaNaH
shlokas.28:
tathAnyAnapi nighnantaM yuyudhAnaM samantataH |
abhyadhAvaddhRRiShIkesho vinivArayiShustadA
shlokas.29:
ekIbhUtAstataH sarve kAlaparyAyachoditAH |
bhojAndhakA mahArAja shaineyaM paryavArayan
shlokas.30:
tAndRRiShTvA patatastUrNamabhikruddhA~njanArdanaH |
na chukrodha mahAtejA jAnankAlasya paryayam
shlokas.32:
hanyamAne tu shaineye kruddho rukmiNinandanaH |
tadantaramupAdhAvanmokShayiShya~nshineH sutam
shlokas.33:
sa bhojaiH saha sa.nyuktaH sAtyakishchAndhakaiH saha |
bahutvAnnihatau tatra ubhau kRRiShNasya pashyataH
shlokas.34:
hataM dRRiShTvA tu shaineyaM putraM cha yadunandanaH |
erakANAM tadA muShTiM kopAjjagrAha keshavaH
shlokas.35:
tadabhUnmusalaM ghoraM vajrakalpamayomayam |
jaghAna tena kRRiShNastAnye.asya pramukhato.abhavan
shlokas.36:
tato.andhakAshcha bhojAshcha shaineyA vRRiShNayastathA |
jaghnuranyonyamAkrande musalaiH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.37:
yasteShAmerakAM kashchijjagrAha ruShito nRRipa |
vajrabhUteva sA rAjannadRRishyata tadA vibho
shlokas.38:
tRRiNaM cha musalIbhUtamapi tatra vyadRRishyata |
brahmadaNDakRRitaM sarvamiti tadviddhi pArthiva
shlokas.39:
AvidhyAvidhya te rAjanprakShipanti sma yattRRiNam |
tadvajrabhUtaM musalaM vyadRRishyata tadA dRRiDham
shlokas.40:
avadhItpitaraM putraH pitA putraM cha bhArata |
mattAH paripatanti sma pothayantaH parasparam
shlokas.41:
pata~NgA iva chAgnau te nyapatankukurAndhakAH |
nAsItpalAyane buddhirvadhyamAnasya kasyachit
shlokas.42:
taM tu pashyanmahAbAhurjAnankAlasya paryayam |
musalaM samavaShTabhya tasthau sa madhusUdanaH
shlokas.43:
sAmbaM cha nihataM dRRiShTvA chArudeShNaM cha mAdhavaH |
pradyumnaM chAniruddhaM cha tatashchukrodha bhArata
shlokas.44:
gadaM vIkShya shayAnaM cha bhRRishaM kopasamanvitaH |
sa niHsheShaM tadA chakre shAr~NgachakragadAdharaH
shlokas.45:
taM nighnantaM mahAtejA babhruH parapura~njayaH |
dArukashchaiva dAshArhamUchaturyannibodha tat
shlokas.46:
bhagavansaMhRRitaM sarvaM tvayA bhUyiShThamachyuta |
rAmasya padamanvichCha tatra gachChAma yatra saH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato yayurdArukaH keshavashcha; babhrushcha rAmasya padaM patantaH |
athApashyanrAmamanantavIryaM; vRRikShe sthitaM chintayAnaM vivikte
shlokas.2:
tataH samAsAdya mahAnubhAvaH; kRRiShNastadA dArukamanvashAsat |
gatvA kurU~nshIghramimaM mahAntaM; pArthAya sha.nsasva vadhaM yadUnAm
shlokas.3:
tato.arjunaH kShipramihopayAtu; shrutvA mRRitAnyAdavAnbrahmashApAt |
ityevamuktaH sa yayau rathena; kurU.nstadA dAruko naShTachetAH
shlokas.4:
tato gate dAruke keshavo.atha; dRRiShTvAntike babhrumuvAcha vAkyam |
striyo bhavAnrakShatu yAtu shIghraM; naitA hi.nsyurdasyavo vittalobhAt
shlokas.5:
sa prasthitaH keshavenAnushiShTo; madAturo j~nAtivadhArditashcha |
taM vai yAntaM saMnidhau keshavasya; tvarantamekaM sahasaiva babhrum
brahmAnushaptamavadhInmahadvai; kUTonmuktaM musalaM lubdhakasya
shlokas.6:
tato dRRiShTvA nihataM babhrumAha; kRRiShNo vAkyaM bhrAtaramagrajaM tu |
ihaiva tvaM mAM pratIkShasva rAma; yAvatstriyo j~nAtivashAH karomi
shlokas.7:
tataH purIM dvAravatIM pravishya; janArdanaH pitaraM prAha vAkyam |
striyo bhavAnrakShatu naH samagrA; dhana~njayasyAgamanaM pratIkShan
rAmo vanAnte pratipAlayanmA;mAste.adyAhaM tena samAgamiShye
shlokas.8:
dRRiShTaM mayedaM nidhanaM yadUnAM; rAj~nAM cha pUrvaM kurupu~NgavAnAm |
nAhaM vinA yadubhiryAdavAnAM; purImimAM draShTumihAdya shaktaH
shlokas.9:
tapashchariShyAmi nibodha tanme; rAmeNa sArdhaM vanamabhyupetya |
itIdamuktvA shirasAsya pAdau; sa.nspRRishya kRRiShNastvarito jagAma
shlokas.10:
tato mahAnninadaH prAdurAsI;tsastrIkumArasya purasya tasya |
athAbravItkeshavaH saMnivartya; shabdaM shrutvA yoShitAM kroshatInAm
shlokas.11:
purImimAmeShyati savyasAchI; sa vo duHkhAnmochayitA narAgryaH |
tato gatvA keshavastaM dadarsha; rAmaM vane sthitamekaM vivikte
shlokas.12:
athApashyadyogayuktasya tasya; nAgaM mukhAnniHsarantaM mahAntam |
shvetaM yayau sa tataH prekShyamANo; mahArNavo yena mahAnubhAvaH
shlokas.13:
sahasrashIrShaH parvatAbhogavarShmA; raktAnanaH svAM tanuM tAM vimuchya |
samyakcha taM sAgaraH pratyagRRihNA;nnAgA divyAH saritashchaiva puNyAH
shlokas.14:
karkoTako vAsukistakShakashcha; pRRithushravA varuNaH ku~njarashcha |
mishrI sha~NkhaH kumudaH puNDarIka;stathA nAgo dhRRitarAShTro mahAtmA
shlokas.15:
hrAdaH krAthaH shitikaNTho.agratejA;stathA nAgau chakramandAtiShaNDau |
nAgashreShTho durmukhashchAmbarIShaH; svayaM rAjA varuNashchApi rAjan
pratyudgamya svAgatenAbhyanandaM;ste.apUjaya.nshchArghyapAdyakriyAbhiH
shlokas.16:
tato gate bhrAtari vAsudevo; jAnansarvA gatayo divyadRRiShTiH |
vane shUnye vichara.nshchintayAno; bhUmau tataH sa.nviveshAgryatejAH
shlokas.17:
sarvaM hi tena prAktadA vittamAsI;dgAndhAryA yadvAkyamuktaH sa pUrvam |
durvAsasA pAyasochChiShTalipte; yachchApyuktaM tachcha sasmAra kRRiShNaH
shlokas.18:
sa chintayAno.andhakavRRiShNinAshaM; kurukShayaM chaiva mahAnubhAvaH |
mene tataH sa~NkramaNasya kAlaM; tatashchakArendriyasaMnirodham
shlokas.19:
sa saMniruddhendriyavA~NmanAstu; shishye mahAyogamupetya kRRiShNaH |
jarAtha taM deshamupAjagAma; lubdhastadAnIM mRRigalipsurugraH
shlokas.20:
sa keshavaM yogayuktaM shayAnaM; mRRigAsha~NkI lubdhakaH sAyakena |
jarAvidhyatpAdatale tvarAvAM;staM chAbhitastajjighRRikShurjagAma
athApashyatpuruShaM yogayuktaM; pItAmbaraM lubdhako.anekabAhum
shlokas.21:
matvAtmAnamaparAddhaM sa tasya; jagrAha pAdau shirasA chArtarUpaH |
AshvAsayattaM mahAtmA tadAnIM; gachChannUrdhvaM rodasI vyApya lakShmyA
shlokas.22:
divaM prAptaM vAsavo.athAshvinau cha; rudrAdityA vasavashchAtha vishve |
pratyudyayurmunayashchApi siddhA; gandharvamukhyAshcha sahApsarobhiH
shlokas.23:
tato rAjanbhagavAnugratejA; nArAyaNaH prabhavashchAvyayashcha |
yogAchAryo rodasI vyApya lakShmyA; sthAnaM prApa svaM mahAtmAprameyam
shlokas.24:
tato devairRRiShibhishchApi kRRiShNaH; samAgatashchAraNaishchaiva rAjan |
gandharvAgryairapsarobhirvarAbhiH; siddhaiH sAdhyaishchAnataiH pUjyamAnaH
shlokas.25:
te vai devAH pratyanandanta rAja;nmunishreShThA vAgbhirAnarchurIsham |
gandharvAshchApyupatasthuH stuvantaH; prItyA chainaM puruhUto.abhyanandat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dAruko.api kurUngatvA dRRiShTvA pArthAnmahArathAn |
AchaShTa mausale vRRiShNInanyonyenopasaMhRRitAn
shlokas.3:
tato.arjunastAnAmantrya keshavasya priyaH sakhA |
prayayau mAtulaM draShTuM nedamastIti chAbravIt
shlokas.4:
sa vRRiShNinilayaM gatvA dArukeNa saha prabho |
dadarsha dvArakAM vIro mRRitanAthAmiva striyam
shlokas.5:
yAH sma tA lokanAthena nAthavatyaH purAbhavan |
tAstvanAthAstadA nAthaM pArthaM dRRiShTvA vichukrushuH
shlokas.7:
tAstu dRRiShTvaiva kauravyo bAShpeNa pihito.arjunaH |
hInAH kRRiShNena putraishcha nAshakatso.abhivIkShitum
shlokas.8:
tAM sa vRRiShNyandhakajalAM hayamInAM rathoDupAm |
vAditrarathaghoShaughAM veshmatIrthamahAgrahAm
shlokas.10:
rAmakRRiShNamahAgrAhAM dvArakAsaritaM tadA |
kAlapAshagrahAM ghorAM nadIM vaitaraNImiva
shlokas.11:
tAM dadarshArjuno dhImAnvihInAM vRRiShNipu~NgavaiH |
gatashriyaM nirAnandAM padminIM shishire yathA
shlokas.12:
tAM dRRiShTvA dvArakAM pArthastAshcha kRRiShNasya yoShitaH |
sasvanaM bAShpamutsRRijya nipapAta mahItale
shlokas.13:
sAtrAjitI tataH satyA rukmiNI cha vishAM pate |
abhipatya praruruduH parivArya dhana~njayam
shlokas.14:
tatastAH kA~nchane pIThe samutthAyopaveshya cha |
abruvantyo mahAtmAnaM parivAryopatasthire
shlokas.15:
tataH sa.nstUya govindaM kathayitvA cha pANDavaH |
AshvAsya tAH striyashchApi mAtulaM draShTumabhyagAt

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taM shayAnaM mahAtmAnaM vIramAnakadundubhim |
putrashokAbhisantaptaM dadarsha kurupu~NgavaH
shlokas.2:
tasyAshruparipUrNAkSho vyUDhorasko mahAbhujaH |
ArtasyArtataraH pArthaH pAdau jagrAha bhArata
shlokas.3:
samAli~NgyArjunaM vRRiddhaH sa bhujAbhyAM mahAbhujaH |
rudanputrAnsmaransarvAnvilalApa suvihvalaH
bhrAtR^InputrA.nshcha pautrA.nshcha dauhitrA.nshcha sakhInapi
shlokas.4:
vasudeva uvAcha||
yairjitA bhUmipAlAshcha daityAshcha shatasho.arjuna |
tAndRRiShTvA neha pashyAmi jIvAmyarjuna durmaraH
shlokas.5:
yau tAvarjuna shiShyau te priyau bahumatau sadA |
tayorapanayAtpArtha vRRiShNayo nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.6:
yau tau vRRiShNipravIrANAM dvAvevAtirathau matau |
pradyumno yuyudhAnashcha kathayankatthase cha yau
shlokas.7:
nityaM tvaM kurushArdUla kRRiShNashcha mama putrakaH |
tAvubhau vRRiShNinAshasya mukhamAstAM dhana~njaya
shlokas.8:
na tu garhAmi shaineyaM hArdikyaM chAhamarjuna |
akrUraM raukmiNeyaM cha shApo hyevAtra kAraNam
shlokas.9:
keshinaM yastu ka.nsaM cha vikramya jagataH prabhuH |
videhAvakarotpArtha chaidyaM cha balagarvitam
shlokas.10:
naiShAdimekalavyaM cha chakre kAli~NgamAgadhAn |
gAndhArAnkAshirAjaM cha marubhUmau cha pArthivAn
shlokas.11:
prAchyA.nshcha dAkShiNAtyA.nshcha pArvatIyA.nstathA nRRipAn |
so.abhyupekShitavAnetamanayaM madhusUdanaH
shlokas.12:
tataH putrA.nshcha pautrA.nshcha bhrAtR^Inatha sakhInapi |
shayAnAnnihatAndRRiShTvA tato mAmabravIdidam
shlokas.13:
samprApto.adyAyamasyAntaH kulasya puruSharShabha |
AgamiShyati bIbhatsurimAM dvAravatIM purIm
shlokas.14:
AkhyeyaM tasya yadvRRittaM vRRiShNInAM vaishasaM mahat |
sa tu shrutvA mahAtejA yadUnAmanayaM prabho
AgantA kShiprameveha na me.atrAsti vichAraNA
shlokas.15:
yo.ahaM tamarjunaM viddhi yo.arjunaH so.ahameva tu |
yadbrUyAttattathA kAryamiti budhyasva mAdhava
shlokas.16:
sa strIShu prAptakAlaM vaH pANDavo bAlakeShu cha |
pratipatsyati bIbhatsurbhavatashchaurdhvadehikam
shlokas.17:
imAM cha nagarIM sadyaH pratiyAte dhana~njaye |
prAkArATTAlakopetAM samudraH plAvayiShyati
shlokas.18:
ahaM hi deshe kasmi.nshchitpuNye niyamamAsthitaH |
kAlaM kartA sadya eva rAmeNa saha dhImatA
shlokas.19:
evamuktvA hRRiShIkesho mAmachintyaparAkramaH |
hitvA mAM bAlakaiH sArdhaM dishaM kAmapyagAtprabhuH
shlokas.20:
so.ahaM tau cha mahAtmAnau chintayanbhrAtarau tava |
ghoraM j~nAtivadhaM chaiva na bhu~nje shokakarshitaH
shlokas.21:
na cha bhokShye na jIviShye diShTyA prApto.asi pANDava |
yaduktaM pArtha kRRiShNena tatsarvamakhilaM kuru
shlokas.22:
etatte pArtha rAjyaM cha striyo ratnAni chaiva ha |
iShTAnprANAnahaM hImA.nstyakShyAmi ripusUdana

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa bIbhatsurmAtulena parantapaH |
durmanA dInamanasaM vasudevamuvAcha ha
shlokas.2:
nAhaM vRRiShNipravIreNa madhubhishchaiva mAtula |
vihInAM pRRithivIM draShTuM shaktashchiramiha prabho
shlokas.3:
rAjA cha bhImasenashcha sahadevashcha pANDavaH |
nakulo yAj~nasenI cha ShaDekamanaso vayam
shlokas.4:
rAj~naH sa~NkramaNe chApi kAlo.ayaM vartate dhruvam |
tamimaM viddhi samprAptaM kAlaM kAlavidAM vara
shlokas.5:
sarvathA vRRiShNidArA.nstu bAlavRRiddhA.nstathaiva cha |
nayiShye parigRRihyAhamindraprasthamari.ndama
shlokas.6:
ityuktvA dArukamidaM vAkyamAha dhana~njayaH |
amAtyAnvRRiShNivIrANAM draShTumichChAmi mAchiram
shlokas.7:
ityevamuktvA vachanaM sudharmAM yAdavIM sabhAm |
praviveshArjunaH shUraH shochamAno mahArathAn
shlokas.8:
tamAsanagataM tatra sarvAH prakRRitayastathA |
brAhmaNA naigamAshchaiva parivAryopatasthire
shlokas.9:
tAndInamanasaH sarvAnnibhRRitAngatachetasaH |
uvAchedaM vachaH pArthaH svayaM dInatarastadA
shlokas.10:
shakraprasthamahaM neShye vRRiShNyandhakajanaM svayam |
idaM tu nagaraM sarvaM samudraH plAvayiShyati
shlokas.11:
sajjIkuruta yAnAni ratnAni vividhAni cha |
vajro.ayaM bhavatAM rAjA shakraprasthe bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
saptame divase chaiva ravau vimala udgate |
bahirvatsyAmahe sarve sajjIbhavata mAchiram
shlokas.13:
ityuktAstena te paurAH pArthenAkliShTakarmaNA |
sajjamAshu tatashchakruH svasiddhyarthaM samutsukAH
shlokas.14:
tAM rAtrimavasatpArthaH keshavasya niveshane |
mahatA shokamohena sahasAbhipariplutaH
shlokas.15:
shvobhUte.atha tataH shaurirvasudevaH pratApavAn |
yuktvAtmAnaM mahAtejA jagAma gatimuttamAm
shlokas.16:
tataH shabdo mahAnAsIdvasudevasya veshmani |
dAruNaH kroshatInAM cha rudatInAM cha yoShitAm
shlokas.17:
prakIrNamUrdhajAH sarvA vimuktAbharaNasrajaH |
urA.nsi pANibhirghnantyo vyalapankaruNaM striyaH
shlokas.18:
taM devakI cha bhadrA cha rohiNI madirA tathA |
anvAroDhuM vyavasitA bhartAraM yoShitAM varAH
shlokas.19:
tataH shauriM nRRiyuktena bahumAlyena bhArata |
yAnena mahatA pArtho bahirniShkrAmayattadA
shlokas.20:
tamanvayustatra tatra duHkhashokasamAhatAH |
dvArakAvAsinaH paurAH sarva eva nararShabha
shlokas.21:
tasyAshvamedhikaM ChatraM dIpyamAnAshcha pAvakAH |
purastAttasya yAnasya yAjakAshcha tato yayuH
shlokas.22:
anujagmushcha taM vIraM devyastA vai svala~NkRRitAH |
strIsahasraiH parivRRitA vadhUbhishcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.23:
yastu deshaH priyastasya jIvato.abhUnmahAtmanaH |
tatrainamupasa~Nkalpya pitRRimedhaM prachakrire
shlokas.24:
taM chitAgnigataM vIraM shUraputraM varA~NganAH |
tato.anvAruruhuH patnyashchatasraH patilokagAH
shlokas.25:
taM vai chatasRRibhiH strIbhiranvitaM pANDunandanaH |
adAhayachchandanaishcha gandhairuchchAvachairapi
shlokas.26:
tataH prAdurabhUchChabdaH samiddhasya vibhAvasoH |
sAmagAnAM cha nirghoSho narANAM rudatAmapi
shlokas.27:
tato vajrapradhAnAste vRRiShNivIrakumArakAH |
sarva evodakaM chakruH striyashchaiva mahAtmanaH
shlokas.28:
aluptadharmastaM dharmaM kArayitvA sa phalgunaH |
jagAma vRRiShNayo yatra vinaShTA bharatarShabha
shlokas.29:
sa tAndRRiShTvA nipatitAnkadane bhRRishaduHkhitaH |
babhUvAtIva kauravyaH prAptakAlaM chakAra cha
shlokas.30:
yathApradhAnatashchaiva chakre sarvAH kriyAstadA |
ye hatA brahmashApena musalairerakodbhavaiH
shlokas.31:
tataH sharIre rAmasya vAsudevasya chobhayoH |
anviShya dAhayAmAsa puruShairAptakAribhiH
shlokas.32:
sa teShAM vidhivatkRRitvA pretakAryANi pANDavaH |
saptame divase prAyAdrathamAruhya satvaraH
ashvayuktai rathaishchApi gokharoShTrayutairapi
shlokas.33:
striyastA vRRiShNivIrANAM rudatyaH shokakarshitAH |
anujagmurmahAtmAnaM pANDuputraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.34:
bhRRityAstvandhakavRRiShNInAM sAdino rathinashcha ye |
vIrahInaM vRRiddhabAlaM paurajAnapadAstathA
yayuste parivAryAtha kalatraM pArthashAsanAt
shlokas.35:
ku~njaraishcha gajArohA yayuH shailanibhaistathA |
sapAdarakShaiH sa.nyuktAH sottarAyudhikA yayuH
shlokas.36:
putrAshchAndhakavRRiShNInAM sarve pArthamanuvratAH |
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyAH shUdrAshchaiva mahAdhanAH
shlokas.37:
dasha ShaTcha sahasrANi vAsudevAvarodhanam |
puraskRRitya yayurvajraM pautraM kRRiShNasya dhImataH
shlokas.38:
bahUni cha sahasrANi prayutAnyarbudAni cha |
bhojavRRiShNyandhakastrINAM hatanAthAni niryayuH
shlokas.39:
tatsAgarasamaprakhyaM vRRiShNichakraM maharddhimat |
uvAha rathinAM shreShThaH pArthaH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.40:
niryAte tu jane tasminsAgaro makarAlayaH |
dvArakAM ratnasampUrNAM jalenAplAvayattadA
shlokas.41:
tadadbhutamabhiprekShya dvArakAvAsino janAH |
tUrNAttUrNataraM jagmuraho daivamiti bruvan
shlokas.42:
kAnaneShu cha ramyeShu parvateShu nadIShu cha |
nivasannAnayAmAsa vRRiShNidArAndhana~njayaH
shlokas.43:
sa pa~nchanadamAsAdya dhImAnatisamRRiddhimat |
deshe gopashudhAnyADhye nivAsamakarotprabhuH
shlokas.44:
tato lobhaH samabhavaddasyUnAM nihateshvarAH |
dRRiShTvA striyo nIyamAnAH pArthenaikena bhArata
shlokas.45:
tataste pApakarmANo lobhopahatachetasaH |
AbhIrA mantrayAmAsuH sametyAshubhadarshanAH
shlokas.46:
ayameko.arjuno yoddhA vRRiddhabAlaM hateshvaram |
nayatyasmAnatikramya yodhAshcheme hataujasaH
shlokas.47:
tato yaShTipraharaNA dasyavaste sahasrashaH |
abhyadhAvanta vRRiShNInAM taM janaM loptrahAriNaH
shlokas.48:
mahatA siMhanAdena drAvayantaH pRRithagjanam |
abhipeturdhanArthaM te kAlaparyAyachoditAH
shlokas.49:
tato nivRRittaH kaunteyaH sahasA sapadAnugaH |
uvAcha tAnmahAbAhurarjunaH prahasanniva
shlokas.50:
nivartadhvamadharmaj~nA yadi stha na mumUrShavaH |
nedAnIM sharanirbhinnAH shochadhvaM nihatA mayA
shlokas.51:
tathoktAstena vIreNa kadarthIkRRitya tadvachaH |
abhipeturjanaM mUDhA vAryamANAH punaH punaH
shlokas.52:
tato.arjuno dhanurdivyaM gANDIvamajaraM mahat |
AropayitumArebhe yatnAdiva katha~nchana
shlokas.53:
chakAra sajyaM kRRichChreNa sambhrame tumule sati |
chintayAmAsa chAstrANi na cha sasmAra tAnyapi
shlokas.54:
vaikRRityaM tanmahaddRRiShTvA bhujavIrye tathA yudhi |
divyAnAM cha mahAstrANAM vinAshAdvrIDito.abhavat
shlokas.55:
vRRiShNiyodhAshcha te sarve gajAshvarathayAyinaH |
na shekurAvartayituM hriyamANaM cha taM janam
shlokas.56:
kalatrasya bahutvAttu sampatatsu tatastataH |
prayatnamakarotpArtho janasya parirakShaNe
shlokas.57:
miShatAM sarvayodhAnAM tatastAH pramadottamAH |
samantato.avakRRiShyanta kAmAchchAnyAH pravavrajuH
shlokas.58:
tato gANDIvanirmuktaiH sharaiH pArtho dhana~njayaH |
jaghAna dasyUnsodvego vRRiShNibhRRityaiH saha prabhuH
shlokas.59:
kShaNena tasya te rAjankShayaM jagmurajihmagAH |
akShayA hi purA bhUtvA kShINAH kShatajabhojanAH
shlokas.60:
sa sharakShayamAsAdya duHkhashokasamAhataH |
dhanuShkoTyA tadA dasyUnavadhItpAkashAsaniH
shlokas.61:
prekShatastveva pArthasya vRRiShNyandhakavarastriyaH |
jagmurAdAya te mlechChAH samantAjjanamejaya
shlokas.63:
astrANAM cha praNAshena bAhuvIryasya sa~NkShayAt |
dhanuShashchAvidheyatvAchCharANAM sa~NkShayeNa cha
shlokas.64:
babhUva vimanAH pArtho daivamityanuchintayan |
nyavartata tato rAjannedamastIti chAbravIt
shlokas.65:
tataH sa sheShamAdAya kalatrasya mahAmatiH |
hRRitabhUyiShTharatnasya kurukShetramavAtarat
shlokas.66:
evaM kalatramAnIya vRRiShNInAM hRRitasheShitam |
nyaveshayata kauravyastatra tatra dhana~njayaH
shlokas.67:
hArdikyatanayaM pArtho nagaraM mArtikAvatam |
bhojarAjakalatraM cha hRRitasheShaM narottamaH
shlokas.68:
tato vRRiddhA.nshcha bAlA.nshcha striyashchAdAya pANDavaH |
vIrairvihInAnsarvA.nstA~nshakraprasthe nyaveshayat
shlokas.69:
yauyudhAniM sarasvatyAM putraM sAtyakinaH priyam |
nyaveshayata dharmAtmA vRRiddhabAlapuraskRRitam
shlokas.70:
indraprasthe dadau rAjyaM vajrAya paravIrahA |
vajreNAkrUradArAstu vAryamANAH pravavrajuH
shlokas.71:
rukmiNI tvatha gAndhArI shaibyA haimavatItyapi |
devI jAmbavatI chaiva vivishurjAtavedasam
shlokas.72:
satyabhAmA tathaivAnyA devyaH kRRiShNasya saMmatAH |
vanaM pravivishU rAja.nstApasye kRRitanishchayAH
shlokas.73:
dvArakAvAsino ye tu puruShAH pArthamanvayuH |
yathArhaM sa.nvibhajyainAnvajre paryadadajjayaH
shlokas.74:
sa tatkRRitvA prAptakAlaM bAShpeNApihito.arjunaH |
kRRiShNadvaipAyanaM rAjandadarshAsInamAshrame

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
pravishannarjuno rAjannAshramaM satyavAdinaH |
dadarshAsInamekAnte muniM satyavatIsutam
shlokas.2:
sa tamAsAdya dharmaj~namupatasthe mahAvratam |
arjuno.asmIti nAmAsmai nivedyAbhyavadattataH
shlokas.3:
svAgataM te.astviti prAha muniH satyavatIsutaH |
AsyatAmiti chovAcha prasannAtmA mahAmuniH
shlokas.4:
tamapratItamanasaM niHshvasantaM punaH punaH |
nirviNNamanasaM dRRiShTvA pArthaM vyAso.abravIdidam
shlokas.5:
avIrajo.abhighAtaste brAhmaNo vA hatastvayA |
yuddhe parAjito vAsi gatashrIriva lakShyase
shlokas.6:
na tvA pratyabhijAnAmi kimidaM bharatarShabha |
shrotavyaM chenmayA pArtha kShipramAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.7:
arjuna uvAcha||
yaH sa medhavapuH shrImAnbRRihatpa~NkajalochanaH |
sa kRRiShNaH saha rAmeNa tyaktvA dehaM divaM gataH
shlokas.8:
mausale vRRiShNivIrANAM vinAsho brahmashApajaH |
babhUva vIrAntakaraH prabhAse romaharShaNaH
shlokas.9:
ye te shUrA mahAtmAnaH siMhadarpA mahAbalAH |
bhojavRRiShNyandhakA brahmannanyonyaM tairhataM yudhi
shlokas.10:
gadAparighashaktInAM sahAH parighabAhavaH |
ta erakAbhirnihatAH pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.11:
hataM pa~nchashataM teShAM sahasraM bAhushAlinAm |
nidhanaM samanuprAptaM samAsAdyetaretaram
shlokas.12:
punaH punarna mRRishyAmi vinAshamamitaujasAm |
chintayAno yadUnAM cha kRRiShNasya cha yashasvinaH
shlokas.13:
shoShaNaM sAgarasyeva parvatasyeva chAlanam |
nabhasaH patanaM chaiva shaityamagnestathaiva cha
shlokas.14:
ashraddheyamahaM manye vinAshaM shAr~NgadhanvanaH |
na cheha sthAtumichChAmi loke kRRiShNavinAkRRitaH
shlokas.15:
itaH kaShTataraM chAnyachChRRiNu tadvai tapodhana |
mano me dIryate yena chintayAnasya vai muhuH
shlokas.16:
pashyato vRRiShNidArAshcha mama brahmansahasrashaH |
AbhIrairanusRRityAjau hRRitAH pa~nchanadAlayaiH
shlokas.17:
dhanurAdAya tatrAhaM nAshakaM tasya pUraNe |
yathA purA cha me vIryaM bhujayorna tathAbhavat
shlokas.18:
astrANi me pranaShTAni vividhAni mahAmune |
sharAshcha kShayamApannAH kShaNenaiva samantataH
shlokas.19:
puruShashchAprameyAtmA sha~NkhachakragadAdharaH |
chaturbhujaH pItavAsA shyAmaH padmAyatekShaNaH
shlokas.20:
yaH sa yAti purastAnme rathasya sumahAdyutiH |
pradahanripusainyAni na pashyAmyahamadya tam
shlokas.21:
yena pUrvaM pradagdhAni shatrusainyAni tejasA |
sharairgANDIvanirmuktairahaM pashchAdvyanAshayam
shlokas.22:
tamapashyanviShIdAmi ghUrNAmIva cha sattama |
parinirviNNachetAshcha shAntiM nopalabhe.api cha
shlokas.23:
vinA janArdanaM vIraM nAhaM jIvitumutsahe |
shrutvaiva hi gataM viShNuM mamApi mumuhurdishaH
shlokas.24:
pranaShTaj~nAtivIryasya shUnyasya paridhAvataH |
upadeShTuM mama shreyo bhavAnarhati sattama
shlokas.25:
vyAsa uvAcha||
brahmashApavinirdagdhA vRRiShNyandhakamahArathAH |
vinaShTAH kurushArdUla na tA~nshochitumarhasi
shlokas.26:
bhavitavyaM tathA taddhi diShTametanmahAtmanAm |
upekShitaM cha kRRiShNena shaktenApi vyapohitum
shlokas.27:
trailokyamapi kRRiShNo hi kRRitsnaM sthAvaraja~Ngamam |
prasahedanyathA kartuM kimu shApaM manIShiNAm
shlokas.28:
rathasya purato yAti yaH sa chakragadAdharaH |
tava snehAtpurANarShirvAsudevashchaturbhujaH
shlokas.29:
kRRitvA bhArAvataraNaM pRRithivyAH pRRithulochanaH |
mokShayitvA jagatsarvaM gataH svasthAnamuttamam
shlokas.30:
tvayA tviha mahatkarma devAnAM puruSharShabha |
kRRitaM bhImasahAyena yamAbhyAM cha mahAbhuja
shlokas.31:
kRRitakRRityA.nshcha vo manye sa.nsiddhAnkurupu~Ngava |
gamanaM prAptakAlaM cha taddhi shreyo mataM mama
shlokas.32:
balaM buddhishcha tejashcha pratipattishcha bhArata |
bhavanti bhavakAleShu vipadyante viparyaye
shlokas.33:
kAlamUlamidaM sarvaM jagadbIjaM dhana~njaya |
kAla eva samAdatte punareva yadRRichChayA
shlokas.34:
sa eva balavAnbhUtvA punarbhavati durbalaH |
sa eveshashcha bhUtveha parairAj~nApyate punaH
shlokas.35:
kRRitakRRityAni chAstrANi gatAnyadya yathAgatam |
punareShyanti te hastaM yadA kAlo bhaviShyati
shlokas.36:
kAlo gantuM gatiM mukhyAM bhavatAmapi bhArata |
etachChreyo hi vo manye paramaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.37:
etadvachanamAj~nAya vyAsasyAmitatejasaH |
anuj~nAto yayau pArtho nagaraM nAgasAhvayam
shlokas.38:
pravishya cha purIM vIraH samAsAdya yudhiShThiram |
